name: Budget phase
description: Where a figure sits in the budget cycle, as the Fiscal Data Package defines it. Publishers skip this field more than any other. But it matters most: a proposed figure and an executed figure for the same line are different numbers. Comparing them without knowing which is which gives you nonsense.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Proposed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Put forward by the executive, before the legislature has acted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Approved
hasDefinedTerm.description: Adopted by the legislature. The legally binding budget.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Adjusted
hasDefinedTerm.description: Approved, then changed during the year through a supplemental appropriation or transfer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Executed
hasDefinedTerm.description: What was actually spent or received. Usually final only after an audit.
